item.title: Tangipahoa Parish under burn ban
item.description: AMITE - Starting Sunday, residents in Tangipahoa Parish are under a burn ban.&nbsp;Parish President Robby Miller issued the ban Sunday afternoon. He said the extremely dry conditions led to the decision.&nbsp;&ldquo;After talking with the fire chiefs and upon review of the local forecast, we agree that a burn ban is appropriate at this time,&rdquo; Miller said.Residents are banned from doing any residential or commercial burning. item.title: I-12 shut down for 3 hours due to active wildfires
item.description: LACOMBE &mdash; A large fire along I-12 near the Lacombe exit shut down traffic for at least three hours on Sunday, according to the National Weather Service.&nbsp;St. Tammany Parish fire crews are working several forest fires in the area, with heavy smoke crossing I-12. item.description: BELLE ROSE - One person was killed and two were injured in an "industrial accident" at a Belle Rose plant on Sunday, according to Assumption Parish Office of Emergency Preparedness Director Paul LeBlanc.LeBlanc said a crew was doing a routine pressure test on a brine well at the GIE plant off Grand Bayou Road when the equipment failed.&nbsp;A loose hose struck three people, killing one. item.description: BATON ROUGE - Feb. 17 marked two years since St. Luke's Episcopal Church burned down.
